about.text: A summer alpine cheese of the Belluno Prealps and Dolomites, made from partly skimmed raw cow's milk in alpine huts (malghe). Its standard ageing is 30 to 35 days, and the aged version, which Slow Food protects, ages two to nine months; a recent study said only one malga in six still makes it by tradition.
